title: Hilb^d of a closed subscheme is a closed subscheme of Hilb^d
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)

difficulty_reason: Prove that a closed immersion i : X -> Y induces a closed immersion on Hilb functors when Hilb^d_{Y/S} is representable: claim there is a closed subscheme T_X of T parametrizing precisely those base changes where Z_{T'} factors through X_{T'}; applied to the universal object over T_univ this yields T_{univ,X} representing Hilb^d_{X/S} with universal object Z_univ,X (formal argument); prove the claim via Z' = X_T x_{Y_T} Z and the very general flat-lemma-Weil-restriction-closed-subschemes, and give the direct special-case proof: reduce to T = Spec(A), Z = Spec(B) with B = A^{oplus d}, write Z' = Spec(B/J) with generators g_beta of J, then T_X = Spec(A/(g_beta^j)) using the chosen isomorphism phi : B -> A^{oplus d}.
